content:
Friday, November 27th 2026
![Rockstar Games](https://tpucdn.com/images/news/rockstargames-v1795442328.png)
During the lead-up to the launch of the immensely successful GTA VI, it was revealed that Rockstar had previously considered setting a GTA game in Tokyo but had ultimately shelved the game, with former studio executive, Obbe Vermeij, commenting that part of the reason for backing out of an international GTA was the potential risk associated with such a high-budget game—Rockstar was effectively playing it safe. More recently, in an interview with Eurogamer, following the launch of GTA VI, Rockstar co-studio head, Rob Nelson, suggested that a Grand Theft Auto game set outside the US was unlikely, however he cited different reasons for the decision.
I don't know...It's just that there never ceases to be a more interesting place to think about setting it. I just think that it's constantly changing, there's constantly stuff for us to respond to, and it works from a gameplay standpoint in terms of what we want to do. We have not had a lot of conversations over doing it anywhere else.
